text:
rachel: Quick update on the Horizon RFI packet were sending to the buyer. I dropped a new capability_matrix.xlsx and rfi_appendix.docx into /deals/horizon/rfi. Main asks: explicit POC throughput, HSM/KMS options, network peering diagrams, and three pricing bands incl. a single-month dedicated POC rate. Can security/ops/finance check wording?

dmitri: I'll take the security questions. Short replies we can use: Private = BYO-HSM (PKCS#11) + optional private control plane; Dedicated = customer-managed cloud KMS support (we recommend CMEK); Hosted = cloud KMS integration only, no raw key access. I'll prepare a one-paragraph FAQ entry for rfi_appendix.

noah: Ops: baseline POC numbers vary by model and request mix. Suggested line items: "13B family on 4xA100: ~380 reqs/s (16 tok avg); 70B family on 8xA100 equiv: ~90 reqs/s". Also include an embedding throughput row. I'll attach a minimal CSV and a short note about assumptions (avg tokens, concurrency, warm cache).

katie: Finance: buyer wants bands at 50k, 500k, 2M tokens/mo plus a dedicated POC month price. Can finance provide quick delta % between hosted and dedicated for those bands? They also asked about cancellation terms for POC.

rachel: Also they asked for EU residency and peering. Can we confirm eu-west-1 hosting + optional private peering into their VPC for Dedicated/Private? Need to mention control plane locality caveat.

ods-bot: Note: RFI deadline 2025-03-01 23:00 UTC. Please upload final artifacts to /deals/horizon/rfi/FINAL.

dmitri: Draft HSM paragraph (paste):

"Private deployments support customer-provided HSMs via PKCS#11-compatible interfaces. We provide integration guidance and sample attestation scripts. Dedicated deployments support cloud KMS/CMEK with customer key ownership; hosted integrates with cloud KMS only. For customers requiring FIPS-validated HSMs, we recommend Private with customer-procured hardware"

noah: CSV (paste):

```
model,instance,baseline_reqs_s,burst_reqs_s,assumptions
horizon-13b,4xA100,380,680,16 token avg, moderate concurrency
horizon-70b,8xA100,90,170,16 token avg, large-context opts
embed-s,2xA100,1300,2100,embedding only
```

katie: Finance to-do: i'll run quick back-of-envelope for 50k/500k/2M. Expect hosted base rate X, dedicated +25% baseline, POC-month flat fee $15k (TBD legal). I'll post numbers by EOD Wed.

rachel: Two buyer blockers: 1) legal wants liability cap language for data egress; 2) they need confirmation of a handover runbook post-POC. Who owns the runbook?

noah: Ops will own the runbook draft. I'll prepare a 2-page runbook with autoscale commands, warming steps, and rollback procedures.

dmitri: Also flag: mention fallback policy in matrix: when Dedicated capacity is exhausted we can route to a host-protected variant with lower SLA; include that as a caveat line.

rachel: Action list: dmitri finish security paragraph + FedRAMP control mapping (due Tue EOD); noah finalize throughput CSV + runbook draft (due Tue noon); katie post pricing bands (due Tue EOD); rachel assemble final packet and do one last sign-off.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach files to /deals/horizon/rfi/FINAL for versioning.

rachel: Thanks all, Ill schedule a 20m readthrough Thu 9am. If anything blocks drop it here.
